   [b]  For troubleshooting:

[/b][list]
[*][b]If you’re experiencing issues with your saved game, such as annoying bushes appearing on the map, here are two solutions:[/b]
[/list]

     [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/127?tab=files]Stardew Valley Save Editor[/url]:
[list]
[*]This tool allows you to delete the bushes directly from your save file. Once deleted, they will never reappear.
[/list]
    [b]Option 2: [/b]

    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304?tab=files]Destroyable Bushes[/url]: 
[list]

[/list]

     These options should help you resolve any issues with unwanted bushes on your map. 😊


     This mod offers a meticulously designed farm layout that maximizes utility while maintaining distinct zones for various activities. The farm is not only       highly functional but also aesthetically pleasing and customizable, allowing players to personalize their space.

   [b]  Specs:
[/b]
[list]
[/list]   [b]  Cropping Area: [/b]
[list]
[*]The farm features a 30 x 30 cropping area, divided into six zones, accommodating a total of 5400 crops. You can place Junimo huts in this area for an automated planting system. If complemented with the Better Junimos and Better Junimos Forestry mods, you can have auto-planting and more features.
[/list]  [b]   Hive Areas: [/b]
[list]
[*]There are four designated areas for hives, each housing 216 hives, resulting in a total of 864 hives. These areas are designed to work efficiently with the Automate mod.
[/list]     [b]Resin Trees: [/b]
[list]
[*]An area is specifically allocated for resin trees, with a capacity for 54 trees. This area is also optimized for use with the Automate mod.
[/list]    [b] Fishing Ponds: [/b]
[list]
[*]The farm includes a space for placing miniature fishing ponds using the “Smaller Fish Ponds” mod. This area measures 3 x 3, accommodating a total of 100 ponds. It is designed to work well with the Automate mod.
[/list]     [b]External Greenhouse and Animal Housing: [/b]
[list]
[*]Adjacent to the external greenhouse planting area measuring 29 x 29, there’s space to position barns, chicken coops, and silos.
[/list]    [b] Production Area: [/b]
[list]
[*]There’s an area for producing wines, jams, juices, etc., with space for up to 1980 items using the Automate mod.
[/list]   [b]  Spouse Forest: [/b]
[list]
[*]A secret forest is available for your seven spouses, complemented by a flower planting area to enhance the view.
[/list]     [b]Obelisks: [/b]
[list]
[*]The farm has allocated space for four obelisks. With the retexture package, these obelisks can be beautifully arranged.
[/list]     [b]Mini Obelisks:[/b]
[list]
[*] For multiple mini obelisks, the entire map has spots designated to accommodate them. This allows players to teleport from one area to another seamlessly.
[/list]
[b]The entrance to the Spouse Forest is located next to the totem by the fence leading to that area. For access to other areas, the entrance is located next to Grandpa’s Shrine. If your game is new, you won’t be able to access all areas until you have the axe and pickaxe to destroy large stones and logs. This would require level 2 tools.
This map is tailored to integrate with various mods such as Automate, Better Junimos, and Better Junimos Forestry. These mods ensure spectacular synergy and enhance efficiency significantly. The design of this map keeps different zones separate and organized, leaving your farm clutter-free and highly customizable. It’s perfect for players who want a clean, organized farm while having everything they need within reach.

[/b]
